name: Tabs
description: Radix Tabs with roving focus and automatic activation. Content is unmounted when inactive by default.
intent: Switch between peer views of the same subject, where only one is relevant at a time.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Arrow keys — move between and activate tabs
requiredAttributes: aria-label on TabsList when there is no visible heading
notes: Radix wires tablist, tab and tabpanel roles plus aria-selected and aria-controls.
Activation is automatic: arrowing to a tab selects it. For expensive content use activationMode="manual" so arrow keys only move focus.
Inactive content is unmounted, so form state inside a tab is lost on switch. Use forceMount if that matters.

usage: Alternative views of one object — Overview, Activity, Settings
Peer sections where the user rarely needs two at once
Two to six sections with short labels
doNotUse: Sequential steps — use a stepper or separate routes; tabs imply order does not matter
Content the user needs to compare side by side
More than about six sections, or labels that will not fit
Content that should be linkable — unless you sync the active tab to the URL

agentRules: Label the TabsList when no visible heading names it.
Every trigger value must match a content value.
Use activationMode="manual" when panels are expensive to render.
Tabs are not steps. A wizard needs routes or a stepper.
Sync to the URL if a tab should be shareable.

related.note: Vertical disclosure, several open at once

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
